text:
alex: heads-up — eu-central GPU pool is overloaded. ~6 pods pending >10m, autoscaler is flipping between two nodegroups (spot-eu, ondemand-eu) and we're seeing repeated spot terminations. cost alarms firing.
provisioner-bot: ALERT: GPUProvisionerPoolUtilization(eu-central)=0.92, scale_attempts=14 in 12m. recent_reason=SpotInterruptions.
sre-oncall: on it. any long-running batch jobs? can we identify a runaway?
alex: looks like a research hyperparam sweep (priorityClass=high-research) kicked off last night with 120 concurrent jobs. they requested GPUs directly.
nina: if it's priorityClass=high-research it's blocking lower-priority production inference that relies on ondemand fallback — we should either preempt or throttle the sweep.
maria: tagging @research leads, but immediate mitigation: 1) reduce concurrency for the sweep 2) pause autoscaler fallback to spot for the research pool 3) enable provisioner circuit-breaker to stop churn.
leo: commands I'm running:
```
kubectl get pods -n research -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Pending
kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=eu-gpu -o wide
kubectl scale job hyperparam-sweep -n research --replicas=20
```
leo: also applied temporary taint to research nodepool to stop new scheduling: `kubectl taint nodes -l nodepool=eu-gpu research-throttle=true:NoSchedule`
sre-oncall: good. i've set `autoscaler.kubernetes.io/spot-fallback=false` on the research provisioner to force ondemand. that will slow down scale but avoid flapping from spot interruptions.
ops-bot: NOTE: Changed nodepool eu-gpu config: spot_fallback=false (requested by sre-oncall). Will take ~2m to propagate.
alex: after lowering sweep concurrency we cleared 4 pending pods, cost spike stabilized but autoscaler attempted 6 launches and 4 terminations in 10m. any extra quick wins?
maria: temporarily reduced research priorityClass to batch-low via admission webhook patch so kube-scheduler can preempt if needed. created follow-up ticket OPS-374: "eu-central provisioner hysteresis + circuit breaker tuning" and assigned to infra.
nina: action items: (1) infra: tune provisioner hysteresis to 90s and enable circuit-breaker flag (2) research: limit parallel sweeps and use queueing (3) finance: review last 6h cost delta.
leo: leaving a small kubectl snippet to rollback if needed:
```
# revert priority bump
kubectl patch job hyperparam-sweep -n research -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"priorityClass":"high-research"}}}}}'
```
provisioner-bot: INFO: circuit-breaker=enabled for provisioner eu-gpu; hysteresis set to 90s.
alex: thanks team. monitoring for 30m, will escalate if we see another oscillation. :thumbsup:
